summary: Build practical HR AI governance, bias review, and human oversight skills. Explore use cases and create draft controls. View the course outline.
lede: Responsible AI in HR training helps people teams govern AI use across hiring, learning, performance, and workforce planning. For HR leaders, talent acquisition and L&D teams, and people analytics practitioners, it develops skills to map use-case risks, check data and selection criteria, and set human-review and escalation steps using practical governance templates and decision workflows.
audienceIntro: AI in HR training is designed for professionals responsible for selecting, governing, or monitoring AI use in people processes, including teams balancing productivity goals with fairness, employee trust, and accountable decision-making.
audience: Responsible AI and data governance specialists
modules: AI in HR: Use Cases and Boundaries
NIST AI RMF: Mapping HR Risks
AI Hiring: Job Analysis and Validation
NIST AI RMF: Assurance and Reporting
prerequisites: Working familiarity with at least one HR process, such as recruitment, learning, performance management, or workforce planning. No coding or programming is required. Bring a laptop with access to Excel, Word, and PowerPoint if you want to complete the digital-template exercises; no dedicated AI platform is required.
